evidence.note: The NameID element is missing from the assertion. This fits the claim change the admin made and the AADSTS75016 error.

evidence.actual: Recipient, InResponseTo and NotOnOrAfter are present and consistent
evidence.note: The rest of the Subject is valid, so the fault is isolated to the NameID.

output.fix: In Entra, open the app's SAML single sign-on settings and go to Attributes & Claims. Edit the "Unique User Identifier (Name ID)" claim. Set its source attribute to one that always has a value, such as user.mail. Set the Name identifier format to Email address (urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress). Keep the SP's expected NameID format the same. Don't weaken any validation on the SP side. Then re-capture a response and confirm that the signed assertion has a Subject/NameID with that format.

alternatives.why_not: The email and firstName attributes are both present. Only the NameID is missing.
